notes: This file is the single source of truth for everything a role IS: how it reads,
what it may do, and what it is allowed to know. Behaviour lives in js/roles/<id>.js;
that module is validated against this entry at load time, so the two cannot drift.
The game is house-first: you pick a HOUSE and are then offered the actions your
role can perform there. So every action carries a `houses` selector (which doors
it lights up) rather than a flat list of legal targets.
`icon` names a glyph in js/ui/icons.js. Never an emoji: they render as a different
picture on every platform and they are the loudest possible signal that a thing is
a web page rather than a game. Copy is kept short for the same reason - a player
reading a paragraph is a player not playing.

village.name: Village
village.goal: Eliminate every werewolf and every cult member.
village.description: The many, and the only side that has to work out who it is.

werewolf.name: Werewolves
werewolf.goal: Equal or outnumber the village with no cult left standing.
werewolf.description: They know each other from night one. They kill by agreement.

cult.name: The Cult
cult.goal: Hold as many living souls as every other side combined.
cult.description: Grows by conversion. Slow, then sudden.

solo.name: Solo
solo.goal: Varies. Each solo role carries its own private victory.
solo.description: Wins alone, usually at everyone else's expense.

supernatural.name: Supernatural
supernatural.description: Reads as uncanny to anything that can sense it.

animal.name: Animal
animal.description: Cannot speak in words during the day.

houseSelectors.any: Every house in the village, occupied or empty, living or dead.
houseSelectors.living-others: Houses of living players, except your own.
houseSelectors.living-any: Houses of living players, your own included.
houseSelectors.living-not-last: Living players, except the one you chose last night.
houseSelectors.dead-wolves: Dead players who were on the werewolf team.
houseSelectors.dead-pets: Dead Cats and Dogs who have not been treated before.
houseSelectors.dead-tonight: Houses whose occupant died during the current night.
houseSelectors.living-non-cult: Living players not already on the cult team.
houseSelectors.living-cult: Living players on the cult team.
houseSelectors.living-non-wolf: Living players not on the werewolf team.

chargeModes.used: The player field counts actions SPENT; charges left is `charges` minus it. The default.
chargeModes.remaining: The player field IS the number left, and counts down to zero.

roles.name: Werewolf
roles.description: Votes with the pack for tonight's kill.
roles.lore: The pack does not argue for long.
roles.winCondition: Outnumber all villagers.
knows: Every living member of the werewolf team
Every house marked by the Wolf Shaman
Deaths the Shaman hid from the village

actions.label: Howl for this house
actions.houseVerb: Mark this door for the pack
actions.description: Vote for tonight's kill. The Alpha's vote counts twice.

passives.name: Pack Sight
passives.description: You see your pack and their votes, live.

passives.name: Bad Meat
passives.description: Kill a Diseased villager and you die of it.

roles.name: Alpha Wolf
roles.tagline: Turns the village into the pack.
roles.description: Bites a villager. Two nights later they wake up a wolf.
roles.lore: Killing is loud. A bite is not.
roles.winCondition: Outnumber all villagers.
knows: Every living member of the werewolf team
Who you have infected and how long they have left

actions.label: Howl for this house
actions.houseVerb: Mark this door for the pack
actions.description: Your vote for the kill counts twice.

actions.label: Infect
actions.houseVerb: Slip inside and bite them in their sleep
actions.description: They keep their role for two nights, then turn. Told nothing.

passives.name: Double Howl
passives.description: Your vote for the kill is worth two.

roles.name: Wolf Shaman
roles.description: Marks a house. The pack's kill there leaves no body.
roles.lore: No body, no story. Just an empty chair.
roles.winCondition: Outnumber all villagers.
knows: Every living member of the werewolf team
Every death you have hidden

actions.label: Howl for this house
actions.houseVerb: Mark this door for the pack
actions.description: Vote for tonight's kill.

actions.label: Mark for silence
actions.houseVerb: Draw the silencing sign on this door
actions.description: One mark at a time. A marked kill is never announced.

passives.name: Unburied
passives.description: A marked victim leaves no body and no reveal.

roles.name: Albularyo
roles.description: Brings one dead wolf back, once per game.
roles.lore: Herbs, salt, a whispered name.
roles.winCondition: Outnumber all villagers.
knows: Every living member of the werewolf team

actions.label: Howl for this house
actions.houseVerb: Mark this door for the pack
actions.description: Vote for tonight's kill.

actions.label: Call them back
actions.houseVerb: Sit with the body and begin the rites
actions.description: They wake now and can act tonight. Never announced.

passives.name: Quiet Work
passives.description: Your revival is never announced.

roles.name: Villager
roles.description: No power. Works through the night, and earns one.
roles.lore: Nobody hands a villager a title.
roles.winCondition: Eliminate all werewolves.
knows: Who the Mayor is, once a Mayor exists

actions.label: Do the night's work
actions.houseVerb: Stay in and work
actions.description: A short puzzle. Score enough and the village promotes you.

passives.name: Promotion
passives.description: 1000 points of night work buys you a real role.

roles.name: Seer
roles.description: Learns one player's role each night.
roles.lore: The hard part is being believed.
roles.winCondition: Help the village eliminate every werewolf.
knows: The true role of anyone you read, subject to disguises

actions.label: Read them
actions.houseVerb: Look through the window and read what is inside
actions.description: Their role, at once. A Lycan reads as a Werewolf.

roles.name: Doctor
roles.tagline: Stands between a knife and a neck.
roles.description: Shields one player. Never the same one twice running.
roles.lore: You are not told whether you were needed.
roles.winCondition: Keep the village alive long enough to win it.
knows: Whether your patient was attacked while you were there

actions.label: Keep watch
actions.houseVerb: Sit up with them through the night
actions.description: Turns aside anything that arrives after you do.

passives.name: Rounds
passives.description: Not the same house two nights running.

roles.name: Bodyguard
roles.description: Stands at a door and dies in place of whoever is behind it.
roles.lore: The Doctor turns the blade aside. You are where it was going.
roles.winCondition: Protect the people who matter and eliminate the wolves.
knows: Whether anyone came for your charge tonight

actions.label: Guard this house
actions.houseVerb: Stand at the door all night
actions.description: The next lethal attack kills you instead. Arrive late, find a body.

roles.name: Detective
roles.description: Learns where a player went last night, and who came to them.
roles.lore: Roles lie. Movement does not.
roles.winCondition: Work out who is hunting, and get the village to listen.
knows: Last night's comings and goings at any one house

actions.label: Read the tracks
actions.houseVerb: Study the mud on the step
actions.description: Where they went, and how many came to theirs. Names, not roles.

roles.name: Engineer
roles.tagline: Sets a bell, not a blade.
roles.description: Rigs a door. Every visitor is named to you, live.
roles.lore: Wire, a latch, a tin can.
roles.winCondition: Catch the traffic and hand the village a name.
knows: Everyone who entered your trapped house tonight, in order

actions.label: Set the trap
actions.houseVerb: Rig the doorway
actions.description: You get a name the moment anyone walks in. Spent at dawn.

roles.name: Avenger
roles.description: Names someone. If you die, so do they.
roles.lore: Point at whoever you would take with you.
roles.winCondition: Take a wolf down with you.

actions.label: Swear revenge
actions.houseVerb: Swear that if you fall, this house falls with you
actions.description: Re-swearable nightly. Fires whether you are eaten or hanged.

passives.name: Last Word
passives.description: Night or noon, the oath still fires.

roles.name: Witch
roles.description: One saving potion, one killing potion. Once each.
roles.lore: Both bottles look the same in the dark.
roles.winCondition: Villager-aligned. Spend the bottles well.

actions.label: Save
actions.houseVerb: Pour the clear bottle at their threshold
actions.description: Turns aside anything arriving after you. Once.

actions.label: Poison
actions.houseVerb: Pour the dark bottle at their threshold
actions.description: Kills at once, through most wards. Once.

roles.name: Mason
roles.description: Knows every other Mason from night one.
roles.lore: One relationship nobody had to take on trust.
roles.winCondition: Build the trust the village votes on.
knows: Every other living Mason

actions.label: Do the night's work
actions.houseVerb: Stay in and work
actions.description: No night power beyond knowing each other.

passives.name: Brotherhood
passives.description: You and the other Masons see each other every night.

roles.name: Mayor
roles.description: Public. Every villager knows you. So does the pack.
roles.lore: The first honest voice the pack removes.
roles.winCondition: Lead the village to victory.

actions.label: Do the night's work
actions.houseVerb: Stay in and work
actions.description: The Mayor's power is entirely daylight.

passives.name: Known Face
passives.description: Every village player sees your role. You are a target.

roles.name: Lycan
roles.description: A villager who reads as a Werewolf to everyone.
roles.lore: Not enough to howl with. Enough to hang for.
roles.winCondition: Villager-aligned, and good luck proving it.
knows: That you will be read as a Werewolf

passives.name: False Scent
passives.description: Every reader sees a Werewolf.

roles.name: Diseased
roles.description: The wolf that kills you dies of it.
roles.lore: You will not survive the night. Neither will they.
roles.winCondition: If the wolves take you, they lose one of their own.

passives.name: Bad Meat
passives.description: A werewolf kill on you kills that wolf.

roles.name: Doppelgänger
roles.description: Takes another player's role, and team, for good.
roles.lore: Not a disguise. You stop being what you were.
roles.winCondition: You win with whichever team you end up on.
knows: The role you copied, from the moment you take it

actions.label: Become them
actions.houseVerb: Study them until you are them
actions.description: Their role and their side become yours. Once, permanently.

roles.name: Trickster
roles.description: Wears another player's role for investigators.
roles.lore: The Seer is only as reliable as your last choice.
roles.winCondition: Survive to the end with the village.
knows: The role view of whoever you last copied

actions.label: Wear their face
actions.houseVerb: Take on the shape of this house
actions.description: Readers see them, not you. You get their role's view.

passives.name: Worn Face
passives.description: Investigations return the copied role.

roles.name: Naughty Boy
roles.description: Swaps two players' roles. Once.
roles.lore: Neither of them is told.
roles.winCondition: Cause chaos and survive it with the village.
knows: Both roles you swapped

actions.label: Swap this house with another
actions.houseVerb: Pick this house as one half of a swap
actions.description: Pick a second house to complete it. Nobody is told.

roles.name: Crazy Naughty Boy
roles.description: Swaps two players' roles. Every night.
roles.lore: By night four, half the village is wrong about itself.
roles.winCondition: Maximum chaos, village victory.
knows: Both roles in every swap you make

actions.label: Swap this house with another
actions.houseVerb: Pick this house as one half of a swap
actions.description: Pick a second house to complete it. No limit.

roles.name: Naughty Ghost
roles.description: A villager alive. A role-swapper once dead.
roles.lore: Killing them is the mistake.
roles.winCondition: Help the village win, alive or otherwise.
knows: Both roles in every swap you make, once dead

actions.label: Do the night's work
actions.houseVerb: Stay in and work
actions.description: Alive, you are a villager and nothing more.

actions.label: Swap this house with another
actions.houseVerb: Reach through and pick this house
actions.description: Only once dead. Pick a second house to complete it.

passives.name: Restless
passives.description: Death is a promotion. You keep taking turns.

roles.name: Archangel
roles.tagline: Raises the dead, and punishes its killers.
roles.description: Survives one attempt, and kills whoever made it.
roles.lore: Whatever is left after the wings come off is only a villager.
roles.winCondition: Protect the village and eliminate the wolves.

actions.label: Raise them
actions.houseVerb: Kneel at the body and call it back
actions.description: They return now, with a new role, in time to act. Once.

passives.name: Divine Retribution
passives.description: Killed by the pack, its howlers die. By anyone else, they do.

passives.name: The Fall
passives.description: Surviving that, or the rope, leaves an ordinary Villager.

roles.name: Diwata
roles.tagline: Kill her and the forest answers.
roles.description: Kill her with teeth and every wolf dies.
roles.lore: The trees keep a count. They settle it at once.
roles.winCondition: Protect the village and eliminate the wolves.

actions.label: Do the night's work
actions.houseVerb: Stay in and hold the ward
actions.description: Her power is passive. The night's work keeps it lit.

passives.name: Forest Curse
passives.description: A werewolf kill on her kills every living werewolf.

passives.name: One Ward
passives.description: The first non-wolf attempt fails. The second demotes her.

roles.name: Vet
roles.description: Brings one dead Cat or Dog back. Once.
roles.lore: Until the village notices the Cat was its only honest witness.
roles.winCondition: Eliminate all werewolves.
knows: Which pets are dead and still treatable

actions.label: Treat them
actions.houseVerb: Carry them in and work on them
actions.description: They wake now and can act tonight. One treatment each, ever.

roles.name: Cat
roles.description: Cannot speak in daylight. Bites in the dark.
roles.lore: It knows which house smells wrong. It cannot tell you.
roles.winCondition: Eliminate all werewolves.
knows: Whether your bite met a wolf — by dying of it

actions.label: Bite
actions.houseVerb: Slip in and bite whoever is sleeping there
actions.description: Harmless, unless they are a wolf. Then you die of it.

passives.name: Meow
passives.description: By day you can send only meows.

roles.name: Dog
roles.description: Cannot speak in daylight. Bites in the dark.
roles.lore: Loud, loyal, unable to explain itself.
roles.winCondition: Eliminate all werewolves.
knows: Whether your bite met a wolf — by dying of it

actions.label: Bite
actions.houseVerb: Slip in and bite whoever is sleeping there
actions.description: Harmless, unless they are a wolf. Then you die of it.

passives.name: Bark
passives.description: By day you can send only barks.

roles.name: Pulis
roles.description: Searches bodies, or shoots. One a night.
roles.lore: Shoot right and they hand you the armoury. Shoot wrong and they take the badge.
roles.winCondition: Eliminate all werewolves.
knows: What the bodies you search were, and what killed them

actions.label: Search the body
actions.houseVerb: Go over the body for clues
actions.description: Their true role, and what killed them. Unlimited.

actions.label: Shoot
actions.houseVerb: Kick the door in
actions.description: Kills now. An innocent demotes you; anyone else clears you.

passives.name: Accountability
passives.description: Killing an innocent demotes you for good.

roles.name: Call Center Agent
roles.description: Puts a player on hold until they answer you.
roles.lore: Your call is important to us.
roles.winCondition: Eliminate all werewolves.
knows: Whether your mark answered correctly

actions.label: Put on hold
actions.houseVerb: Ring this house and keep them talking
actions.description: Tomorrow night they cannot act until they answer. Two calls.

roles.name: Cult Leader
roles.description: Recruits. Wins without killing anyone.
roles.lore: Nobody dies. That is how far it gets before anyone counts.
roles.winCondition: Hold as many living souls as every other side put together.
knows: Every living member of the cult

actions.label: Recruit
actions.houseVerb: Knock, and make the offer
actions.description: They decide, on their phone. Wolves cannot be taken.

passives.name: Succession
passives.description: If you die, every Fanatic is promoted.

roles.name: Cultist
roles.description: Converted. Useless for two more nights.
roles.lore: Same job, same house, same face.
roles.winCondition: Help the cult take the village.
knows: Every living member of the cult

actions.label: Do the night's work
actions.houseVerb: Stay in and keep up appearances
actions.description: Nothing yet. Two nights and you are a Fanatic.

passives.name: Evolution
passives.description: After two nights you become a Fanatic.

roles.name: Fanatic
roles.description: Stands at a cult member's door and dies for them.
roles.lore: No version of this ends with you alive and right.
roles.winCondition: Protect the cult until it is the majority.
knows: Every living member of the cult

actions.label: Guard
actions.houseVerb: Stand watch at this door
actions.description: The next lethal attack on them kills you instead.

roles.name: Fanatic+
roles.description: Wards a cult member outright. No dying required.
roles.lore: Promotion, in a cult, means the last person above you is dead.
roles.winCondition: Lead the cult to victory.
knows: Every living member of the cult

actions.label: Shield
actions.houseVerb: Ward this door
actions.description: Turns aside anything arriving after you. Not twice running.

roles.name: Jester
roles.description: Wins the moment the village hangs you.
roles.lore: Being obviously guilty of nothing is a hard trick.
roles.winCondition: Get yourself eliminated by the village vote.

actions.label: Look busy
actions.houseVerb: Stay in and do something incriminating
actions.description: A suspicious errand. It does nothing. That is the point.

passives.name: Last Laugh
passives.description: The rope wins it. Dying at night does not.

roles.name: Assassin
roles.description: Hunts leaders. Kills by naming a role correctly.
roles.lore: Wrong guess, wrong throat.
roles.winCondition: Kill every team leader — Alpha Wolf, Cult Leader, Mayor and Seer.
knows: Which leaders are still alive
Every role you have stalked, one night late

actions.label: Stalk
actions.houseVerb: Watch this house from the dark
actions.description: Their role, revealed on your next turn. Unlimited.

actions.label: Assassinate
actions.houseVerb: Go in with the knife and a name
actions.description: Name their role. Right, they die. Wrong, you do.

roles.name: Manipulator
roles.tagline: Sees everything, does nothing, wins anyway.
roles.description: Sees every role. Steals whoever's win it was.
roles.lore: They never lifted a finger and the village worked for them.
roles.winCondition: Be alive when anyone else wins. Then it is yours instead.
knows: Every player's true role, every night

actions.label: Watch the board
actions.houseVerb: Stay in and read the room
actions.description: The full list is in front of you. Stay alive.

passives.name: Omniscience
passives.description: You see every player's true role.

passives.name: Theft
passives.description: Any side's win becomes yours, if you are alive. Dead, nothing.

universalActions.label: Report the body
universalActions.description: Free. The village learns at dawn who found them - killers included.

universalActions.label: Look inside
universalActions.description: Walk up to any door. Costs nothing, records nothing.

universalActions.label: Stay home
universalActions.houseVerb: Bolt the door and wait for morning
